Dear EFIC team,

I am applying for the Communications and Advocacy Trainee role. I have built and launched a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, run Google Ads campaigns with a 4.57% CTR, and managed WordPress, Mailchimp and CRM work in my current roles. I am drawn to EFIC's mission to improve pain care across Europe and the chance to support communications and advocacy projects that make a real difference.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear EFIC team,

When I saw that EFIC represents 40 national pain societies and runs advocacy through the Societal Impact of Pain platform, I knew I had to apply. I have spent the last two years building digital communications that get results: a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, a Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and a #3 Google ranking for a client's personal-brand site. I want to bring that same hands-on, results-driven approach to your communications and advocacy work.

In my current role at Episto, I run keyword research, local SEO and link building for clients in consulting, auto and e-commerce. I also support a WooCommerce webshop and track KPIs in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console. As a freelancer, I built two Dutch landing pages for a kids' bike brand, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team. That experience taught me how to communicate clearly with different audiences and how to use data to improve campaigns. I have also built websites in WordPress, managed mailings and worked with CRM systems, which aligns directly with your need for someone who can update website content, run Mailchimp campaigns and manage HubSpot.

What draws me to EFIC is the chance to support advocacy projects that influence policy and improve pain care across Europe. I am organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working under time pressure. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

In the first weeks, I would familiarise myself with your communications plan and advocacy projects, and start contributing to social media posts, mailings and website updates. I would also like to support the European Day on Pain Awareness and SIP policy events. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

## SUMMARY
I want to help EFIC communicate its work to healthcare professionals, policymakers and the public. At Episto I run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for client businesses, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. As a freelancer I bring in my own clients, build Dutch landing pages and present Google Ads results to their team. I built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress in English, Dutch and French, and I track performance in GA4 and Search Console. Years as a tango instructor taught me to work with people daily, build trust and take ownership. I am analytical, follow algorithm updates closely and eager to learn.
